name: Cocoa butter (pressed from liquor)
source: Pressed cocoa fat: illustrative near-pure-fat proximate (per kg) water 2 g, protein 1 g, fat 995 g, ash 2 g — cocoa butter is essentially pure cocoa triglyceride (cocoa science literature).
notes: Standard fat elemental conversion factor as wheat-grain.json (C76/H12/O12%). Pressing (origin/cocoa.ts) divides the liquor's own exact composition between this fat-dominant stream and cocoa-powder's solids-dominant stream using splitByProfile (see plant/unit.ts), so butter mass plus powder mass always sum to exactly the liquor pressed, by construction.
